description: UNDERSTANDING — the demand-side industry rollup: the sectors the profiled companies fall into. Each row carries TWO counts and they answer different questions: `company_count` is the research roster, `profiled_count` is how many of those you can actually read back via find_company_insights(industry:) — size a cohort on profiled_count. The counterpart to find_industries, which counts SUPPLY (providers publishing APIs into a vertical) — this counts DEMAND (companies buying into it). Comparing the two is how you find a sector with buyers and no sellers. Priced B2 (cross-catalog synthesis) — $0.05 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.
